key:P.note: TogglePin on the open session, else the list cursor's; the toast is the TUI's and the row shows ◆ (pinned rows sort first, listmodel.ts)

key:<Space>t.note: ToggleTestingNeeded on a leaf session (a Group or Epic is refused with a reason); the row shows ☐ while marked

key:<Space>r.note: ToggleRotationDisabled; the row shows ⊘ while auto-rotation is off

key:<Space>k.note: CancelRetry; trusts the daemon's cancelled bool ("Retry cancelled" / "No pending retry to cancel"); the row shows the ↻N/M retry badge

key:R.note: RotateSession on the open session when the transcript has the keys, else the list cursor's; only Running, Completed, Interrupted or Failed leaves, as rotate_focused_session; also :rotate

key:<Space>x.note: Continues the open session with /ci_commit (ContinueSession); refused while the session is Starting, as the TUI

key:<Space>gl.note: EnqueueRollingQueueSource dry run, then a plain-words confirm dialog (Land / Cancel; Enter, or the same chord, confirms) from every path including the key and :land; Land queues exactly the shown commit under an operator-land-<uuid> key; queued entries are watched through GetRollingQueue {entry_ids} every 5 s and announced when they settle (land.rs)

cmd:rotate.note: same action as R (named here because it is the same feature as the Normal-mode row)
